The isolines are marked with values such as 12, 14, 16, and 18, indicating that the contour interval of adjacent isolines is 2. B is located between a group of curved isolines in the southwest part of the figure, and does not directly fall on any isoline. Reasoning: According to the isoline distribution, the adjacent isolines on the two sides near point B are 6 and 8 respectively; since B is not on an isoline, its value should be between the values of these two isolines.
